user.title: Choose a network
user.description: Pick the transit network of your stop. STAR works without a key. Île-de-France Mobilités (PRIM key), TCL (data.grandlyon.com account, typed as login:password) and CTS (open data token) need a free key. GTFS-RT covers every other network publishing real-time data on transport.data.gouv.fr.

data_description.api_key: Needed by Île-de-France Mobilités, TCL and CTS; optional for STAR, where it only raises the daily quota.

network_search.title: Find your network
network_search.description: Type a city or a network name. Only the networks of transport.data.gouv.fr that publish real-time data (GTFS-RT) are listed.

network.title: Choose the network
network.description: Networks matching “{query}”. The timetable of the network is downloaded once a day and kept in Home Assistant.

search.title: Find your stop
search.description: Type part of the name of a {network} stop.

stop.title: Choose the stop
stop.description: Stops of the same name are the platforms of each direction: the lines serving each one and the destinations of its next departures (→) are listed after its name.

lines.title: Lines to follow
lines.description: Lines serving {stop}. Each line followed gets its own sensor.

progress.download: Downloading and reading the {network} timetable. This can take a minute for a big network.

error.cannot_connect: The network's open data cannot be reached. Try again later.
error.api_key_required: This network needs an API key.
error.no_network_found: No network with real-time data matches this name.

abort.no_line: The network lists no line for this stop.
abort.cannot_connect: The network's data cannot be reached. Try again later.

data_description.scan_interval: Every stop of the network is updated in one request, at the shortest interval of its stops.
data_description.max_departures: Number of coming departures in the stop sensor's attributes, shown by the card.
data_description.api_key: Leave empty to use the open data API without a key (an emptied field removes the key).

refresh_failed.message: The departures could not be updated: {error}

no_stop.message: No stop of Public Transport is loaded.

network_unavailable.message: The network's open data cannot be reached: {error}

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Updates the departures and alerts of the stops now.

config_entry_id.name: Stop
config_entry_id.description: Refresh only the network of this stop (all networks if empty).
